architecture.mechanism: Development of battery technology making battery electric heavy duty trucks technically and commercially viable
architecture.intervention: Integrate advanced battery cell chemistry and thermal management systems derived from heavy-duty truck applications into the R525 battery pack to increase thermal stability thresholds.
architecture.expected_effect: Enhanced resistance to thermal runaway initiation while maintaining structural integrity for vehicle control and crash safety.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the modified R525 battery pack to accelerated rate calorimetry testing under load conditions simulating heavy-duty truck operations to verify no thermal runaway occurs below the new threshold.
